coverageContext: Han Chinese TPMI research model for primary liver malignancy, with broader liver/intrahepatic training codes and history-of-cancer codes in the evaluation definition; 390 evaluation cases. It is not a hepatocellular-carcinoma-only model. Published performance includes sex, age, array and ancestry covariates, not GA genetics alone. EUR ranks are withheld. No inference of current cancer, hepatitis status, tumor subtype or screening/treatment need.

East Asian nasopharyngeal-carcinoma research score, kept separate from other head-and-neck cancers. Reported AUROC differs for the genetic score alone and with family history. External evaluation includes an EBV VCA-IgA interaction; GA does not infer EBV infection or antibody status and does not calculate that interaction or its large group odds ratio. EUR ranks are withheld. No personal cancer probability, screening recommendation or treatment inference.

UK Biobank research model for diabetic retinopathy with small, ancestry-dependent partial correlations and several intervals including zero. The deposited evaluation does not establish a diabetes-only conditional risk model. GA does not infer diabetes status, retinal damage, severity, progression or screening need. This is not a retinal examination, visual-acuity estimate or covariate-adjusted clinical prediction.
